caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of a pitcher at its center, shown in a three-quarter view. The pitcher is bulbous at the body, with a curved neck, a ruffled rim, and a prominent spout. It has an ornate handle with a decorative curl and three elaborate feet with curling ends. The pitcher is shaded in grayscale, giving it volume and depth against a light beige background. Near the lower left corner, there is a vertical, cylindrical object resembling a pen or stylus, shown in partial section with internal detail visible. In the upper right quadrant, there is a small, simplified line sketch of the pitcher, depicting its basic form and stance. At the lower right corner, the drawing is signed "Amelia Tuccio" and dated "1936."
title: Silver Creamer
